method: Immutable static REA Ghidra; no original execution or device I/O

contracts.profile: 4 layers each 0x900 bytes = 144 records x16; profile+0x38
contracts.matrix: 4 layers of MatrixLen*4; config default128 ->512 bytes/layer; configuration key offset+12 provides matrix index; conversion virtual slot+0x98
contracts.macro: directory pairs LE16 offset,size; payload includes byte name length + name + serialized events; macro index becomes matrix high byte zero-based; profile major tag5
contracts.apply: Apply flag1 sends dirty unmasked layers via virtual+0x5c, then macro buffer via+0x64; configLayerMask suppresses bits; dirty+0x30 cleared before macro write

sourceFields.offset2: u16 state; zero sets serialized bit7 except movement/wheel

macroEvents.delayClamp: upper clamp0xfffff; negative not visibly clamped
macroEvents.name: up to30 UTF16 code units copied as raw60 bytes maximum; leading byte is byte count, no terminator

contracts.vkHelper: 0x482180 takes VK in ECX scans115 HID,VK pairs at0x61a288
contracts.repeat: tag5 matrix bytes03,mode,count,index; object mode+f 0->mode1 count+e,1->mode2 count1,2->mode4 count1

limitations: Static only; zero keyboard I/O and zero target launch
No assembly API in runner allowlist; calling conventions derived from helper bodies/callers
delay units/state polarity not verified
Capacity scratch sizes not supported limits; visible preappend checks incomplete
